title: Harness run settings (harnesses/<name>/harness.yaml)
description: How the runner drives one agent inside its sandbox. Lives next to the harness's sbxenv.yaml, which can't hold these keys (sbx rejects unknown keys).

run.description: Command for one non-interactive eval turn, as argv (no shell), run via `sbx env exec` in the workspace. "{prompt}" is replaced by the eval's prompt as one argument.

inventory.description: Command whose output records what is installed (CLI version, plugins); saved to inventory.txt and the trace tag eval.inventory.

settle_seconds.description: Seconds to wait after the turn before looking for the trace, so the tracing hook has finished uploading.

trace_reader.description: Which trace reader in skill_evals.traces understands this harness's traces (READERS). Harnesses for the same agent share one.
